E2eeCaps.description:
What the joining client can do. The server refuses an
incapable client with `422 e2ee_unsupported_client`, so the values themselves are
not checked here, only their sizes.

ciphersuites.description: MLS ciphersuites the client supports; must contain 1 when present.

key_ring_size.description: 64; anything else is refused at join.

sdk_version.description: The SDK version as its `ClientInfo` reports it.

sender_key_index.description: The SDK can move its sender to a new key slot.

E2eeJoin.description:
The `e2ee` object of a voice or call join (`VoiceJoinRequest.e2ee`, and DM call
joins).

key_package_ref.description: The single-use ref the KeyPackage upload returned (32 bytes).

RecordingNotice.description:
The answer to the consent modal, sent with a voice join or call join/accept.
Joining never implies consent: `consent` is required and `notice_version` must echo the
current [`ConsentPrompt`].

consent.description: The person's answer. Missing → `400 validation_failed`, field `recording_notice.consent`.

notice_version.description: The prompt version the person saw.

call_credential.description:
Flag `call_credential`: mint a call-scoped credential with the answer and key-join
later (a deferred key join with the answer's `join_id`). Never with `e2ee`
(`400 validation_failed`, field `e2ee`). Sent only when `true`.

e2ee.description:
The key join. Required while voice is enabled (unless `call_credential`);
`None` answers `422 e2ee_unsupported_client` with `details.unsupported = e2ee`.

origin.description:
Flag `app_origins`: the web origin the browser reached the App on,
`wss://<host>[:port]`, set by the App's server (behind K2's front too) from
the browser's Host. It must be the session App's `origin` or one of its `origins`
(`422 invalid_state` `origin_not_listed` otherwise), and becomes the answer's `url`.
Absent: the App's `origin` (unchanged behaviour).

recording_notice.description: The answer to the recording consent modal.
